messages:
adele: Noticed onboarding canary for harbor-v2-int8 returning funcall objects that our validator flags as schema-mismatch. Low rate ~0.2% but consistent.
raj k: Saw it in post-deploy logs. Parser throws: 
`jsonschema.ValidationError: 'step' is a required property`
nick: I grabbed a raw stream sample. Something funky at the start of the json chunk: 
```
﻿​{"tool":"run_test","args":{‍"step":1,"payload":{"ok":true}}}
```
There are a BOM (\uFEFF) + zero-width space (\u200B) before the object and a zero-width joiner (\u200D) inserted before the key name step in the args object. Our strict key lookup fails since exact key doesn't match.
adele: Wild. Only seen on streaming + int8 path, not on non-stream or fp16.
triage-bot: alert: funcall-schema-mismatch rate 0.18% (canary harbor-v2-int8) over 50k calls.
raj k: Hypothesis: quantized tokenizer/kernels insert invisible control chars when splitting token chunks; streaming boundary reassembly leaves them in front of tokens that become object keys.
nick: Reproducer: feed model streaming chunks with split token on `"step"`, we see ZW-carry into next chunk. Will attach small reproducer.
qa-bot: Also caught a different failure in end-to-end tests: numeric fields returned as strings like `"1"` which our typed schema rejects. Those are separate but both surfaced during quant onboarding.
adele: Short-term mitigation ideas: 1) pre-parse sanitizer that strips \\uFEFF, \\u200B, \\u200D and other zero-width/control chars globally; 2) relax schema to coerce strings->numbers for known fields; 3) drop streaming for this model in wider canary.
raj k: I prefer (1) + (2) temporarily. Sanitizer is safest and cheap. We'll add a minimal canonicalizer: 
- trim leading BOM/ZW chars before first `{`
- remove ZW characters inside keys (pattern match)
- attempt best-effort coercion for ints/floats on known fields
nick: I'll sketch the sanitizer and unit tests. Also add a fuzz test that inserts ZW chars at chunk boundaries.
triage-bot: note: include metric `funcall_zw_suspect_pct` and `funcall_coerce_applied` for audit.
adele: Can we run an A/B: sanitizer on 20% canary hosts vs control? If drop to <0.01% we promote.
raj k: I'll schedule 100k synthetic streaming invokes across int8, q4f16, fp16 paths to measure baseline. aim for buckets by response length and chunk boundary counts. ETA tomorrow EOD.
nick: Patch ETA: PR for proxy sanitizer + tests (EOD today). Will include example failing payloads in PR description.
qa-bot: Also propose adding a checklist item to onboarding: `streaming boundary fuzz + invisible-char scrub` for quantized variants.
adele: Agree. Long-term we should coordinate with runtime/tokenizer team to avoid emitting invisible chars inside token bytes. Filing ISSUE: https://redwood.example/intern/ISSUE-ml-zw-carry (internal).
raj k: Action items:
- nick: PR for sanitizer + metrics (ETA EOD)
- raj: run 100k cross-quant synthetic (ETA 24h)
- adele: flip 20% canary with sanitizer and monitor (ETA after PR)
- runtime team: triage kernel/tokenizer split-handling (cc @runtime)
adele: Thanks. If sanitizer reduces noise we'll ship to full canary and keep kernel fix as follow-up. :thumbsup:
triage-bot: monitoring continues.
